links.speaker: Hana
links.quote: So, I, um, I got a quote last week. From Northway Haulage.

links.speaker: Hana
links.quote: Them, yeah. What I'd want is Leeds on a consolidated van run, twice a week, from Northway, everything on the one load. It's 4,100 pounds a month. Could start the 26th of June.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: I like the shape of it. One flow, one partner, it's a cleaner story for the region.

links.speaker: Hana
links.quote: About 60 percent of the lines there are slow movers. They just don't need a van most days.

links.speaker: Hana
links.quote: So if you put those drops together, the freight spend comes down by, um, roughly 38 percent.

links.speaker: Arjun
links.quote: Okay, yeah, that does, that works, I was doing it in my head and I got lost at the, uh, never mind.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: So, um, I think we'll say Leeds moves to the twice-weekly Northway run, from the 26th. That's, yes, that's where I'd like us to land.

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: Fine.

links.speaker: Hana
links.quote: Okay.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Yeah, I can frame that for them, sure. I'll get something in front of them this week.

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: Send it before Thursday.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Okay, um, I think maybe we're all- is Zainab on her way, or-

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: Passed. Two bent uprights in bay six. Replaced by the 11th.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Oh, Sunday, gosh, okay, thank you.

links.speaker: Arjun
links.quote: Thursday, the Thai place, half twelve, they've not moved it, I rang them, because last time we all turned up and it was, um, it was shut for a refit.

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: He owes me a sign-off.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Okay, I'll, um, I'll mention it. Maybe gently.

links.speaker: Arjun
links.quote: So, it started, the vans turned up, Thursday and then yesterday, Dave didn't send anybody away, which, with Dave, is a result.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Oh, good. That's, I think that's maybe the main thing we were-

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: Ask what's on the shelf. Actual count.

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: Seals specifically.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Mm. So, um, look, I think, I'm not comfortable pretending this is nothing. But I also don't think, on a few days and without seeing the, the part numbers and what Dave's got, I don't think I can sensibly say anything today.

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: Harlow's a contract.

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: When?

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Um, next week's session? I think maybe, if that's in the diary. Until then it, you know, the vans carry on as they are.

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: Fine. Noted.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: I can pull the log again before then. See if the picture shifts.

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: And I'll get the Harlow ticket numbers.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Thank you. And send them to, maybe to me and Hana?

links.speaker: Arjun
links.quote: I'll report back on the shelf, and I'll put the gate code in the group chat because honestly, that one's going to bite somebody.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Great. Um, should I tell Tom? I think maybe I'd rather wait till I've got the, the actual numbers, otherwise it's just, you know, a bit alarming over a Thai lunch.

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: He still owes me that lease.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Yes. Yes, sorry, the lease, I've written it down this time.

links.speaker: Arjun
links.quote: I've put mine in, second and third weeks, we're going to my sister's in Cork, assuming the ferry doesn't- anyway, they're in.

links.speaker: Hana
links.quote: Mine too.

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: Not booked yet.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: I'll do mine today. Remind me if I don't.

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: Thursday.

links.speaker: Arjun
links.quote: This Thursday? While we're at lunch? Who's letting them in?

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Ha, okay. Well, um, I think that's probably us, unless- no? Thanks, everyone.

links.speaker: Hana
links.quote: Thanks.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Thanks, all.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Okay. I said we'd come back to it once we had more than one week, and now we've got two, and they're as bad as each other.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: So I think maybe we need to properly open it back up, how Leeds gets restocked, rather than just, um, keep watching that log and hoping.

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: Yes.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: I think that's right, yeah.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Okay. Hm. So I think, um, what are we actually saying here? Is the van the problem, or-

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Um, Hana, you know that one better than anyone. Does it hold up, do you think?

links.speaker: Hana
links.quote: The numbers do. Yes.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: And I think maybe Tom won't love a higher line, but it's, hm, it's hard to argue with sixteen against five three.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Right. So, Hana, could you maybe get on to Priya today and start the paperwork with them, and check that cut-off while you're there?

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Thank you. And I'll, um, I'll take the numbers to Tom, the real ones this time, so he doesn't hear it over lunch.

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: Send him the tickets as well.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: I'll need to go back to the service managers, I think, I can frame it as, you know, we looked at the evidence.

links.speaker: Mei
links.quote: Say seals. Say next morning.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Yes, okay, more specific than that, fine. Once Hana has a date from them.

links.speaker: Arjun
links.quote: I'll tell Dave, he'll need to know, and I'll get him to order in those two seals in the meantime if Hana's happy, that's just normal stock anyway.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: And the vans carry on as they are for now, I think, until we've got something signed. Hana, you'll have a look at their terms too?

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Lovely. Um, is there anything else? Oh, the August cover, I think maybe it's still looking a bit thin in the third week.

links.speaker: Yuki
links.quote: Oh, good, okay. Thanks, Mei. Um, I think that's probably us, then.

links.speaker: Zainab
links.quote: Thanks, all. Holiday dates, I'm doing it now.
